description.value: The Muriel Arnason Library is part of the Fraser Valley Regional Library system, serving the Willowbrook neighbourhood of Langley. As a public library, it offers computers, printing, digital resources, and community programming in a welcoming, publicly accessible space. Touring cyclists may find it a useful urban rest stop for connectivity and shelter.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the library's address, phone, and email match OSM exactly (with the addition of unit 130). The website content is mostly navigation UI and contact/hours info — no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water, or cycling-specific amenities, so required criteria cannot be confirmed. OSM has internet_access=wlan, but per rules this tag alone is not authoritative without website corroboration; the website lists 'Computers & Printing' as a service but does not explicitly mention Wi-Fi.
concerns: Website address includes unit number '130' (130 20338 65 Avenue) not present in OSM address field — minor discrepancy, likely a suite/unit omission in OSM.
Required criteria (bike parking, washrooms, water) are entirely unconfirmed — the website contains no amenity detail beyond contact info and navigation.
OSM tag internet_access=wlan suggests Wi-Fi but website does not explicitly confirm it.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library is a legitimate public institution and a plausible cyclist rest stop, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available website content. A site visit or direct inquiry is needed before inclusion.
